capabilities: Highlight RISC-V, ARM, Makefile, linker script, Devicetree, Verilog, VHDL and FPGA constraint code blocks
Show hover cards explaining instructions, registers, CSRs, keywords and numeric values
Highlight pasted objdump and GDB disassembly output with working hover cards
Draw register bitfield diagrams from plain text and decode given register values
Draw memory maps with nested regions, holes, markers and vector tables
extras: Not yet in the community plugin list, so it must be installed manually from a build; the plugin id was misspelled (asmligh) before 0.3.0 and old folders and CSS snippets must be updated. Documents known limitations such as incomplete ISA extension coverage and x86 disassembly getting only partial highlighting.
problem: Obsidian's code block highlighting does not cover assembly, HDL, linker scripts or embedded toolchain formats, and offers no way to look up what an instruction, register or CSR means.
summary: Syntax highlighter and explainer for RISC-V/ARM assembly, Makefiles, linker scripts, Devicetree and HDL, with register and memory map diagrams.
